page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre "MEDICVS" with page number 99 at top right. Main text in one column. In the left margin, a bracketed group of herb names with a side note "Herbae quinq; communes," set beside the brace. Below, a centred heading "DE SVPPOSITORIIS." and further text.

main_text.p: adijciuntur. Estq; communis regula, quòd ad iuris decocti, uel alterius, libram unam, oleorum unc. iiij. uel iij. pinguedinum, mellis, butyri, sachari unc.i. aut s. uitelli ouorum duo, aut tres: salis uerò.3. i. plus minus' ue. Clysterium quidam sunt debiles, quibus utimur in febribus, & in ijs qui longo morbo debilitati, senibus & intestinorum torminibus: uehementiorib.& acrib.in morbis frigid. longis,& qui exitiale uenenum sumpserunt.

Herbae quinq; communes,Malua, Althaea, Mater uiol., Atriplex, Mercurialis. Singulorum quantitas potest esse M.i. decoquatur ad tertias, et colo diffundatur, accipiaturq; iuris decocti lib.1. medullae cassiae uno.1. adijcitur interdum Hierae picrae unc.s.cum mellis rosa.3.iij. olei unc.iij.& salis 3.1.
Clysteres inijci possunt omni tempore, modo duabus aut tribus horis, uel longius à cibo adhibeantur.
main_text.head: DE SVPPOSITORIIS.
main_text.p: Suppositoriorum tria sunt genera. Quaedam leuia: & ista nobis sunt familiaria. fiunt enim ex radice betae, caulis, uel mercurialis, lardo, caseo, stercore humano exiccato, melle perunctis, suillo adipe sal consperso, ficu inuersa,& butyro, adiecto sale. Quaedam uerò mediocria, & fiunt è uitello

page.notes: The left margin carries the herb list in brackets, the list items (Malua, Althaea, Mater uiol., Atriplex, Mercurialis) are set between braces and are reproduced in the text; the margin side note "Herbae quinq; communes," is marginal. Some margin fragments on the far left edge are too faint to read and are omitted. Printed text includes a few doubtful readings such as "perunctis" and "consperso" (last letter uncertain).
